summary: PRIMARY BUG (black placeholder on per-day gallery images) is VERIFIED FIXED. Under CDP network throttling (~250KB/s, 200ms latency) on /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d, the day-gallery main viewer and ALL its thumbnails showed soft BLURRED PREVIEWS (LQIP) — no black box phase — and sharpened in cleanly once the full bitmap decoded. Same blur-up behavior confirmed on a second itinerary (/viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_5n_6d). DOM inspection confirms the dynamic gallery carries class 'img-blurup' plus an inline backgroundImage pointing at the tiny LQIP (/api/files/...?w=24&fmt=auto). After full decode, 'is-loaded' is added and the inline backgroundImage is cleared (no dark residue). Gallery interaction (next arrow) cycles to the next image and the new image also blurs-up → sharpens. After scrolling top-to-bottom and removing throttling: 0 broken images on both trip pages (237/238 and 248/276 loaded, rest are below-fold lazy, all with naturalWidth>0 when in view). No layout shift observed — viewer reserves its aspect-ratio box. Admin regression NOT re-run in this iteration as image-pipeline regression already covered in iteration_47 (Galerías + Biblioteca: 0 broken).
critical_code_review_comments: Img.jsx blur-up logic is correct: lqip URL is built only for optimizable sources, inline backgroundImage is removed on load (style spread only when !loaded), class toggles 'is-loaded'. Clean and minimal.

imageUrl.js lqipSrc uses LQIP_WIDTH=24 → /api/files/...?w=24&fmt=auto, matching the backend's added 24/48 width buckets — verified the LQIP URL is requested and decoded in DevTools (screenshots show real blurred preview content, not the fallback color).

index.css '.img-blurup' uses background-color: #2b2622 (dark warm brown) as a fallback BEFORE the LQIP backgroundImage downloads. This is a sub-second pre-LQIP phase under heavy throttling and never shows pure black. Under normal connections it is imperceptible. Optional polish: warm it to the brand cream (#EDE5D5) so even the sub-LQIP frame is non-dark, matching the cms-skeleton color — but NOT required by the spec and not a bug.

EditableImage SmartImage cms-img-fade pipeline (used for legacy slot galleries / thumbnails) also rendered as soft blurred previews in the throttled screenshot — both pipelines satisfy the no-black requirement.
data-testid 'day-gallery-viewer-<dayId>' present on every day viewer (4+ observed: dia-1, dia-2, dia-3, dia-todra-erfoud). Aspect-ratio reservation prevents CLS — confirmed visually.
